name: lock__state_via_engine
description: F4 fresh-exchange invariant holds for DoorLock cluster (0x0101) attribute LockState (0x0000). External lock-state changes on the CCU (key-pad, manual turn, ReGa) must propagate to Apple Home via a bridge-initiated exchange so the IM:StatusResponse handshake closes — without that, Apple's MTRDevice projection for Lock accessories rubber-bands stale state on the home tile.
